svg.title: The checks of this website
svg.desc: scripts/check.sh runs scripts/check-project.sh last, with the three checks of this website: the tests of its scripts, the table of the projects of projects.toml in README.md and the tests of its hooks. When one fails, the PR coach explains it in the words of .github/checks.project.toml. A table that differs fixes itself: the job of the check runs .github/mkdocs_project.py --write, the fix bot commits README.md onto the branch of the pull request or suggests it on a pull request from a fork, and the checks run again. A test that fails, or a line that no test runs, needs a person, who fixes the code or its test and pushes.
